title: segfaults frequently with rclone bisync

#### What is the problem you are having with rclone?

segfaults when running rclone bisync , not always but frequently

#### What is your rclone version (output from `rclone version`)

rclone v1.68.2
- os/version: fedora 41 (64 bit)
- os/kernel: 6.12.11-200.fc41.x86_64 (x86_64)
- os/type: linux
- os/arch: amd64
- go/version: go1.23.4
- go/linking: dynamic
- go/tags: none



#### Which OS you are using and how many bits (e.g. Windows 7, 64 bit)

linux 64bits (fedora 41)

#### Which cloud storage system are you using? (e.g. Google Drive)

google drive


#### The command you were trying to run (e.g. `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)

rclone bisync  ~/Notes gdrive:notes_vault --exclude ".obsidian/" --exclude=".git/" --progress --color never
